```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(splines)
library(caret)
library(mice)
options(na.action = na.warn)
data("sim1", package = "modelr")
sim1_base <- sim1

set.seed(1)
sim5 <- tibble(
  x = seq(0, 3.5 * pi, length = 50),
  y = 4 * sin(x) + rnorm(50)
)
```

---

## Task 1 — Fit Spline Models

```{r spline-models}
sp_mods <- list(
  df1 = lm(y ~ ns(x, 1), data = sim5),
  df3 = lm(y ~ ns(x, 3), data = sim5),
  df5 = lm(y ~ ns(x, 5), data = sim5)
)
```
